title: CmdPal: Shelf (2/n) - Add recent commands to Home and quick access shelf
summary: The two checkpointed shelf issues are fixed on the fork, all three prior threads are resolved, and targeted CmdPal builds plus 324 unit tests pass. A fresh Copilot pass on the current fork head found one additional valid provider-identity collision in recent-command history, so the review is not converged and no upstream action is ready.

status.label: Review checkpointed — fresh finding remains
status.detail: Fork commit 0c6516f9e reserves every configured pin beyond the display limit and corrects shortcut guidance. The fresh current-head review found that ID-only recent history can resolve the wrong extension when providers share a command ID; that thread remains unresolved pending a provider-qualified history fix.

next_action.label: Resume provider-qualified recent-history fix
next_action.reason: Persist and resolve provider-qualified recent-command identities with an AllApps provider key and an ID-only compatibility path, add collision/migration coverage, rebuild/retest, resolve the remaining fork thread only after correction, then request another fresh review.

judgment.rationale: The requested fork-side fixes are complete and validated, but the freshly requested review of fork head 0c6516f9e produced one new valid inline comment about provider-scoped command ID collisions. Because that correction and a subsequent zero-comment pass were not completed before the stop deadline, the upstream review remains intentionally unavailable.
evidence: Upstream head remains 0f584eec26d12fab32ed3aa70b8d7c4c8e4f5ae2; no microsoft/PowerToys content was created or modified.

Fork commit 0c6516f9e scans all resolvable configured pins for duplicate ownership while limiting only visible pinned output, and updates the localized shortcut guidance to match stable pinned ordering.
Microsoft.CmdPal.UI and Microsoft.CmdPal.UI.ViewModels.UnitTests Debug x64 builds succeeded; the complete ViewModels unit-test assembly passed 324/324 tests, including 27/27 resolver and shelf tests.
The three prior Copilot threads were replied to and resolved only after their corrections were present; the current unresolved count is one.
The fresh review submitted at 2026-09-01T15:58:53Z against 0c6516f9e identified ID-only history as ambiguous when different providers expose the same command ID.
All upstream checks, including CLA, x64/arm64 release builds, and PowerToys CI, are now green.
judgment.recommended_action: Resume the saved fork loop with a provider-qualified recent-history representation and backward compatibility for ID-only entries; do not draft or post upstream content until a fresh zero-comment review and zero unresolved threads are verified.
